page.heading: Skills

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a markdown rule you can attach to any agent.

page.subtitle: Reusable review rules. Every enabled skill linked to an agent is sent in full with its review.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

card.agentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
card.untrusted: Untrusted — sent as data, not instructions

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: A markdown rule agents receive in full with every review.
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: kebab-case: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
create.bodyPlaceholder:

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.tagsHint: Press Enter or comma to add. Type 3+ letters to pick an existing tag.
config.trustedHint: Trusted skills are sent to the model as rules. Untrusted ones are wrapped as data the model must not follow as instructions.
config.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
config.deleteConfirmLinked: Delete skill "{name}"? It is used by {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} and will be removed from them. This cannot be undone.

previewTab.title: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
previewTab.disabledNote: This skill is disabled — agents do not receive it.
previewTab.untrustedNote: Untrusted — agents receive it wrapped as data, not as instructions.

versions.title: Versions
versions.subtitle: Every change except enabling/disabling saves a new immutable version. The active version is what linked agents receive.
versions.activateConfirm: Make v{version} the active version? Linked agents will receive its content from the next review. No new version is created.

import.titleFile: Import a skill from a file
import.titleUrl: Import a skill from a URL
import.subtitle: Nothing is saved until you confirm. Only the markdown is used: scripts and other files in an archive are ignored, never run.
import.fileHint: A .md file with YAML frontmatter (name, description; optional type, tags), or a .zip / .skill archive containing SKILL.md. Max 2 MB.
import.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB.
import.urlHint: https only. GitHub file links are fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com.
import.untrustedNote: Imported skills are untrusted: agents receive the body wrapped as data, not as instructions. It is enabled right away; mark it trusted in Config once you have vetted it.
import.ignoredFiles: {count, plural, one {# file ignored} other {# files ignored}} (not read or executed)
